mapper.select: SELECT id AS employeeId, employee_no AS employeeNo, name, dept_id AS deptId, position_id AS positionId, employee_status AS employeeStatus FROM hr_employee WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.review_id AS reviewId, r.review_no AS reviewNo, r.review_name AS reviewName, r.review_year AS reviewYear, p.grid_cell AS gridCell, p.performance_band AS performanceBand, p.potential_band AS potentialBand, p.performance_score AS performanceScore, p.potential_score AS potentialScore, p.calibration_notes AS calibrationNotes, r.status AS status FROM hr_talent_review_participant p JOIN hr_talent_review r ON r.id = p.review_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.review_year DESC, p.review_id DESC

SELECT m.pool_id AS poolId, p.pool_no AS poolNo, p.pool_name AS poolName, p.pool_type AS poolType, m.joined_at AS joinedAt, m.status AS status FROM hr_talent_pool_member m JOIN hr_talent_pool p ON p.id = m.pool_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'IN' ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC

SELECT id, action_type AS actionType, action_name AS actionName, mentor_id AS mentorId, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, status AS status, evaluation_score AS evaluationScore FROM hr_talent_development_action WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT s.plan_id AS planId, p.plan_no AS planNo, p.plan_name AS planName, p.position_id AS positionId, s.readiness AS readiness, s.rank_order AS rankOrder, s.status AS status FROM hr_talent_successor s JOIN hr_talent_succession_plan p ON p.id = s.plan_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.rank_order ASC
